card.title: How should the package shelf get turned on at workshop?
card.context: Boxes on workshop spend about a minute downloading the same npm packages every time. We built a shared, read-only package shelf so they can skip that. Ivo already approved turning it on at workshop (50 GB shelf, 60 GB per-owner volumes). It is a setting on workshop itself, agents cannot reach that machine, and workshop does not take remote tasks.
card.question: How should the package shelf get turned on at workshop?

choices.label: Bea turns it on at his next visit
Let workshop take remote tasks from owners
choices.pros: agents can apply host settings like this one after an owner approves each card
choices.cons: one more way in to workshop

choices.label: Leave the shelf off at workshop
choices.cons: npm installs stay slow; we can only measure the per-project layers

card.why: Smallest change, and it is one setting. Option b is worth doing later if host settings change often.
